title: Atonement and Salvation Doctrine
summary: Salvation is the work of God through Jesus Christ, who died as a substitutionary sacrifice for sin. Humans are justified by grace through faith, not by works.
historical_context: The sacrificial system of the Old Testament foreshadowed Christ’s atoning death as the Lamb of God.
major_points: All have sinned and fall short of God's glory
Jesus died as substitution for sinners
Salvation is not earned by works
Repentance and regeneration through the Holy Spirit
